title: Complex norm of a root of unity
statement: For every complex number $z$ and natural number $n$, if $z^n=1$ and $n\ne0$, then its complex norm $\|z\|$ (the complex absolute value of [def-weil-complex-absolute-value]) satisfies $\|z\|=1$.

source.place: proof sentence asserting that multiplicativity of the absolute value gives modulus one; exact Mathlib declaration is Mathlib/Analysis/Complex/Basic.lean:101-102
